title: Kiwi's Homes
description: The Ultimate Premium GUI Home Teleportation System.
body:
# 📝 **Description**
Are your players tired of boring chat-based /home commands? Upgrade your server's teleportation experience with Kiwi's Homes!

Kiwi's Homes replaces traditional home systems with a sleek, modern, and highly intuitive GUI. Players can manage their teleportation points visually, seeing exactly which slots are set, which are empty, and which are locked behind ranks.

Designed for performance and aesthetics, this native Java plugin offers a premium feel that fits perfectly into Survival, SMP, Lifesteal, and RPG servers. Give your players the visual clarity they deserve!

## ✨ **Features List**
📱 Paginated GUI Interface: A beautiful multi-page menu (up to 28 homes across 4 pages) to manage homes effortlessly.

![Homes Gui Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d037b43c68f11a3979ca26aea1ad323d1e7aac5a.jpeg)

🔒 Visual Rank Progression:

Red Beds: Homes currently set and ready for teleport.

Light Gray Beds: Available empty slots waiting to be claimed.

Black Beds: Locked slots that visually encourage players to upgrade their rank to unlock more.

![Home Slots: Visualization](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d514c85a549bf9939cfdd971a54de302abe6c718.jpeg)

⚡ Smart Teleportation Logic: Includes a configurable warmup timer (default 5s) with a beautiful Action Bar countdown and integrated movement-canceling to prevent abuse during PvP.

![Action Bar Timer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6767a2406f67410fdfce030a9b661615461c5a1e.png)

🛠️ Fully Customizable: Every aspect of the GUI—menu titles, item names, lore, material types, messages, and sounds—can be edited in the gui.yml and config.yml.

![Config](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6b4336d25f059f0096c2cc73ab87e045decc6cf2.jpeg)

![Gui Config](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8b50d670feaff52ca6bdbdfc27433e07074c0104.jpeg)

💾 Robust Data Saving: Uses efficient flat-file (YML) storage to ensure home data is safe through restarts.

🚀 High Performance: Built as a native Java plugin, ensuring zero lag impact on your server.

## 🎮 **Supported Versions**
This plugin is built against modern APIs and is tested to work flawlessly on:

1.18.x

1.19.x

1.20.x

1.21.x (and newer)

We recommend using PaperSpigot or its forks for the best performance.

## 🛡️ **Permissions**
Admin Permissions
kiwishomes.admin - Allows access to admin commands like /kiwishomes reload to reload config and GUI files instantly.

Player Permissions (Tiered Slots)
Control how many homes a player can set using these nodes. The GUI automatically adjusts based on the highest permission the player has.

kiwi.homes.1 - Grants access to set 1 home.

kiwi.homes.3 - Grants access to set 3 homes.

kiwi.homes.5 - Grants access to set 5 homes.

...up to kiwi.homes.28 (Maximum).

Example: If you give a rank kiwi.homes.5, they will see 5 gray/red slots, and the rest will be black locked slots in the GUI.

## 💌 **A Note from the Developer**
Thank you for choosing Kiwi's Homes for your server!

This plugin was born out of a desire to move away from cluttered chat commands and offer players a visually pleasing, modern way to travel. A lot of love and attention to detail went into the GUI design and sound effects to ensure a premium experience.

If you enjoy using the plugin, a review on the platform would mean the world to me! If you run into any issues or have feature suggestions, please don't hesitate to reach out in the discussion section.

**Happy Teleporting!
~ MissKiwiHere**
